title: Engineering across energy, catering & generative AI
summary: At adesso SE I've grown from Software Engineer into a Senior Software Engineer and AI Expert (promoted in 2025). I lead UI architecture and bridge design and development across very different domains — from enterprise energy dispatch to catering platforms — and today I design and deliver generative-AI solutions for adesso and its customers.
responsibilities: I lead UI architecture and design-system work with Angular, PrimeNG, Tailwind CSS and Telerik/Kendo
I bridge the gap between design and engineering teams as the go-to person for UI/UX
I drive generative-AI enablement and modern DevOps practices
I design and build enterprise AI solutions — RAG assistants, website chatbots and LLM concepts — for customers on Azure
I coach engineers on UI/UX excellence and support technical hiring

children.title: Generative-AI enablement at scale
children.summary: adessoGPT is adesso's modular AI platform and the foundation for customer-specific CompanyGPT solutions. I develop the platform along its release plan and help customers plan and roll out their own CompanyGPT — bringing generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agents securely into their everyday processes.
responsibilities: I develop the adessoGPT platform along its release plan, with DevOps and delivery practices to match
I help customers plan and implement adessoGPT as their own CompanyGPT
I connect company knowledge and data sources via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
I build specialised AI assistants and agents with the Microsoft Agent Framework and MCP servers
I enable generative-AI adoption across teams and use cases
I prototype and evaluate AI-assisted engineering workflows with Claude Code

children.title: A company-wide CorporateGPT with cited sources
children.summary: I design and deliver a company-wide AI chat assistant that gives Vivawest's employees one central, consistent way into their intranet, process and knowledge-management content — with every answer backed by verifiable sources. Along the way I put the original architecture through a technical and commercial feasibility review and re-mapped it onto the native capabilities of adessoGPT.
responsibilities: I integrate Weaviate as the vector database behind the assistant
I connect knowledge-management, intranet and process-management sources to the AI system
I reviewed the original architecture for technical and commercial feasibility and turned the result into an adapted architecture recommendation
I aligned that recommendation with the platform architects — vector stores, observability, operating model, model governance, agent workflows and CI/CD
I help secure acceptance and answer quality with a golden set, hard constraints and a compliance checklist

children.title: An AI chatbot on bvb.de
children.summary: I design and build the chat widget for an AI-powered assistant embedded in bvb.de, Borussia Dortmund's website. Fans ask questions in natural language and get context-aware answers from the connected content sources — in the site's corporate design and consistent across every device.
responsibilities: I design the chatbot widget and its conversation flow
I develop the widget with Angular on a .NET backend
I embed it seamlessly into the existing website and its corporate design
I focus on answer quality and a consistent experience across devices

children.title: Bringing LLMs into e-mail response management
children.summary: For AOK Bayern I analysed how inbound customer e-mails flow through the existing e-mail response management system (ERMS) and designed how large language models can support the entire process — from intake classification and answer drafting to archiving — under strict data-protection and compliance requirements.
responsibilities: I analysed the e-mail handling end-to-end and defined and prioritised suitable LLM use cases
I drafted the target picture and governance — roles, approval mechanisms, quality criteria, error tolerances and no-gos, from suggestion mode to fully automated replies
I designed the technical target architecture and integration concept, covering interfaces, data flows, information security, data minimisation and compliance
I helped shape the pilot strategy with KPIs and success criteria, plus a rough operations and support concept

children.title: Modernising the catering suite (MaxxLive · MaxxConference · MaxxApp)
children.summary: I worked on Gantner DigiRest's catering suite — Angular web apps (MaxxLive for everyday canteen ordering, MaxxConference for conference catering) and a Flutter mobile app (MaxxApp) — where employees order meals and top up their balance via payroll, card, PayPal or SEPA, processed by several payment providers. Each customer tailors the behaviour through an extensive setup module; I modernised the tech stack and the experience.
responsibilities: I implemented customer requirements and improved the tech stack
I integrated and reworked payment providers (e.g. Adyen)
I drove design updates and the rebrand from contidata to Gantner
I maintained the cross-platform MaxxApp

children.title: Re-architecting enterprise energy dispatch (BxTrack)
children.summary: On BxTrack — the central order-management and dispatch hub for field operations in the energy sector, exchanging data bidirectionally with Salesforce and SAP via Apache Kafka — I took on the UI Lead role in a team of 8–12 engineers and steered the migration of a legacy ASP.NET MVC portal to a modern Blazor Server architecture, designing the multi-tenancy concept along the way. The platform dispatches orders to the field technicians' app, turns their reports into customer and closing reports (PDF) and handles ZUGFeRD e-invoicing for SAP.
responsibilities: I led the UI migration from ASP.NET MVC to Blazor Server with Telerik & MudBlazor
I modernised the UI architecture and implemented UI/UX designs from Figma
I designed the multi-tenancy capability across master-data and order management
I operated AWS infrastructure (RDS, EKS, ECR) provisioned entirely as Terraform IaC
I established UI quality gates and supported hiring through interviews

title: Building the ITM suite for the church market
summary: I started my career at ECKD building production software for the church/municipal registry market — owning both front- and backend across the ITM product suite, with the standardised XMeld registry data exchange at its core.
responsibilities: I developed front- and backend features across the ITM suite
I built and maintained CI/CD pipelines on Kubernetes with Helm
I supported requirements engineering and UI/UX design
I worked agile (Scrum/Kanban) with Git and GitFlow

children.title: Mastering the XMeld registry standard
children.summary: I engineered the XMeld processing module at the heart of ITM.KirA — turning high-volume XML registry feeds into a reliable single source of truth and aggregating fragmented person records into the highest-possible data correctness, a challenge I also explored in depth in my bachelor's thesis.
responsibilities: I upgraded the XMeld processing to XMeld 3.0 with gross-message (Bruttonachrichten) handling
I aggregated competing person-data sources into authoritative records
I resolved complex individual registry cases in support consultations
I analysed Big Data & AI opportunities in the ecclesiastical domain
I continuously extended the XMeld processing and supported other ITM.KirA modules

children.title: Campaign landing pages & e-marketing

responsibilities: I developed landing pages and connected them to e-marketing tools
I built CI/CD pipelines and supported deployment
